item.title: Friday will be chilly and gusty with spotty snow showers
item.description: The week of wind ends with more gusty wind in southern Colorado. There is a chance of snow showers across the region throughout the day.

item.title: Fun-filled events across Colorado this weekend February 20 - February 22, 2026
item.description: Each week, News5 compiles a list of events happening across Colorado. From the Cripple Creek Ice Festival to the Polaris Plunge, there's plenty to enjoy this weekend!

item.title: Colorado High School Wrestling State Championship underway at Ball Arena
item.description: The state's best high school wrestlers are facing off on the mats over the next few days. Day one of the Colorado High School Wrestling State Championship at Ball Arena is in the books.
